meta.title: 面试被问手里几个offer，怎么答不吃亏
meta.title_en: How to Answer "Do You Have Other Offers"

scenes.context: 讲者指出被问 offer 时的两个常见错误回答，强调不要这么说。
sentences: 当你面试官问你手上有没有其他 offer 的时候，你会怎么回答？
When the interviewer asks if you have other offers on the table, how do you respond?
手上的 offer：offers on the table
是不是说我手上有几个 offer，还想再看一看？
Do you say you have a few offers and want to look around a bit more?
再看一看：keep looking around
或者实在耿直，直接说我才开始面试还没有 offer？千万不要这么说。
Or, being brutally honest, you say you just started interviewing and have none? Don't say that.
耿直：bluntly honest
paraphrase: 别炫耀也别露怯→两个极端都错
Both bragging and playing weak are wrong.
offer 数量≠诚实度→是筹码
Your offer count is leverage, not a truthfulness test.
scenes.speak: When the interviewer asks if you have other offers on the table, how do you respond? Do you say you have a few offers and want to look around a bit more? Or, being brutally honest, you say you just started interviewing and have none? Don't say that.

scenes.context: 讲者点破这个问题意味着你大概通过面试、占主动权，并拆解 HR 问话的两个意图。
sentences: 这个问题背后意味着你大概是通过了这场面试的，接下来你是占有主动权的。
This question is a sign you've probably passed the interview — the leverage is now yours.
占有主动权：hold the leverage
你 offer 越多，一定程度上能够说明你的能力确实有点东西。
The more offers you have, the more it signals that your skills are actually solid.
有点东西：actually solid / have real substance
也是想评估一下你对他们公司的这个意愿度怎么样，会不会把他们公司当作备胎。
They also want to gauge your enthusiasm for them — will their company just be your backup plan?
当作备胎：treat them as a backup
paraphrase: 被问 offer=已通过面试→占主动权
Getting asked about offers means you've passed — hold the leverage.
两个意图→能力与意愿度的双向评估
It's a double check: your capability and your enthusiasm for them.
scenes.speak: This question is a sign you've probably passed the interview — the leverage is now yours. The more offers you have, the more it signals that your skills are actually solid. They also want to gauge your enthusiasm for them — will their company just be your backup plan?

scenes.title_cn: 分情况话术与谈薪提醒
scenes.context: 讲者给出没 offer 与有 offer 两套话术，并提醒谈薪前别露过往 offer 细节。
sentences: 如果你还没有 offer，可以说我才开始面试、时间不长，目前有一两个机会在复试和终面的阶段。
If you don't have offers yet, say you just started interviewing and have one or two opportunities moving to final rounds.
复试和终面：second round and final rounds
如果你手上有 offer，可以说有收到两三个，并且非常看好咱们公司的发展方向和经营理念。
If you do have offers, mention two or three, and add that you're bullish on their direction and philosophy.
看好公司：be bullish on the company
不到最后谈薪的那一步，不要让 HR 透露你以前 offer 的深入细节。
Until the final salary talk, don't let HR dig into the details of your previous offers.
谈薪：salary negotiation
paraphrase: 没 offer 就说在走流程→不暴露弱势
No offers? Say things are still moving — don't show weakness.
有 offer 报数＋认可→筹码与诚意并用
Have offers? State the count and add genuine interest.
scenes.speak: If you don't have offers yet, say you just started interviewing and have one or two opportunities moving to final rounds. If you do have offers, mention two or three, and add that you're bullish on their direction and philosophy. Until the final salary talk, don't let HR dig into the details of your previous offers.

practice: I have a couple of offers on the table right now.
I've got one or two opportunities moving to the final round.
I'm really bullish on where the company is heading.
I'd rather discuss the details when we talk compensation.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：I have several offers in my hand.
✓ 地道说法：I have a couple of offers on the table.
offers on the table 是面试场景的固定说法。
✕ 直译腔：My ability has some stuff.
✓ 地道说法：My track record speaks for itself.
能力扎实别用 has some stuff，用 track record / solid skills。
✕ 直译腔：Don't let HR disclose your offer details.
✓ 地道说法：Don't let HR dig into the details of your other offers.
dig into 表达「追问细节」更口语。
✕ 直译腔：I am very optimistic about your company.
✓ 地道说法：I'm really bullish on where the company is heading.
bullish on 表达看好，更符合职场语境。
shifts: 被问 offer 就慌乱坦白或露怯
意识到这是通过面试的信号，从容应对
offer 数量越具体越显得诚实
报数点到为止，细节留到谈薪环节
把面试官当考官，全程防御
把他当合作方，筹码与诚意并用
footer_notes: ASR 校正说明：「怀疑」校正为「回答」，「占抵动权」校正为「占有主动权」，「拉滚」校正为「拉回」，「有点滑稠」校正为「有点东西（实力）」，「看左眼的概念」校正为「看走眼的概率」，「被拍」校正为「备胎」，「顾家之别」按语境校正为「实事求是（不卑不亢）」，「复始和终处」校正为「复试和终面」，「看张」校正为「看看」，「谈心」校正为「谈薪」。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
